noResourceCost.label: No Resource Costs
noResourceCost.description: Enables the game operation verified for this build, which runs the affected original routine without resource costs.

infiniteItemUse.label: Infinite Item Use
infiniteItemUse.description: Enables the game operation verified for this build, which prevents consumption for affected item-use calls.

infiniteItemSplit.label: Keep Source Stack When Splitting
infiniteItemSplit.description: Enables the game operation verified for this build, which leaves the source stack unchanged when splitting.

productionTimeEnabled.label: Apply Configured Production Time
productionTimeEnabled.description: Sets every recipe with a positive crafting duration to the configured number of seconds before the game starts. When disabled, original durations are kept.

productionSeconds.label: Production Time in Seconds
productionSeconds.description: Shared base duration for all timed recipes. The world's production speed setting also applies.

groups.label: Resources and Inventory
groups.description: These features run during gameplay and require a runtime operation verified for the current game build.

groups.label: Production
groups.description: The KFC parser updates the complete recipe list before startup. Instant recipes and quantities remain unchanged.
